title: Aaron Glenn on Brendan Sorsby: I'm focused on the guys here now

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Aaron Glenn on Brendan Sorsby: I'm focused on the guys here now
sources.description: Quarterback Brendan Sorsby is applying to enter the NFL's supplemental draft, which means teams will have to mull whether or not they'll make a bid for his services if the league approves that application.
